newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's K.C. Tech, two others apply for IPOs.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's K.C. Tech, two others apply for IPOs.

text.p: South Korea's Securities Supervisory Board said on Monday three companies including K.C. Tech Co Ltd had filed applications for initial public offerings (IPOs).
K.C. Tech, a semiconductor manufacturing equipment maker, plans to offer 435,600 shares at 55,000 won per share and its lead manager is Daewoo Securities.
Kodenshi Korea Corp, an audio and telecom equipment maker, plans to offer 384,800 shares at 25,000 won, with Ssangyong Investment and Securities lead managing the offering.
Dong Yang Power Systems Co Ltd, an electric equipment maker, plans to offer 420,000 shares at 21,000 won, with Tong Yang Securities as the lead manager.
A board official said the applications would be reviewed in September. Schedules for subscription and listing of the shares would be announced later.
